allowed_actions.menu_label: Submit one aggregate request for required review.
Escalate to approver, manager, or policy owner.
Hold as one related set; request aggregate/higher approval before processing
allowed_actions.selection_boundary: Treat the three invoices as a single related spend context (27,000 total) and pause downstream processing until the appropriate aggregate/higher approval is recorded.

allowed_actions.menu_label: Submit invoices separately but cross-link and flag pending aggregate review
allowed_actions.selection_boundary: Create three submissions (one per invoice) for workflow efficiency while explicitly cross-referencing them as a related set and preventing payment release until aggregate review/approval is completed.

allowed_actions.menu_label: Escalate for expedited aggregate review due to month-end backlog (no bypass)
allowed_actions.selection_boundary: Request expedited routing/triage for the aggregate review and approval because queue aging is visible, while keeping the approval requirement unchanged.

allowed_actions.menu_label: Route for exception review request (authority not present; request to obtain it)
allowed_actions.selection_boundary: Because no valid exception authority is currently recorded, submit a request to obtain exception handling (if allowed) while keeping the invoices on hold until that authority or normal approval is recorded.
